SAUK PRAIRIE STATE RECREATION AREA (SPSRA) MASTER PLAN (2016)
This revised master plan document and final EIS contains descriptions of the
proposed use and management of the property, potential impacts, alternatives
evaluated, the public’s inputs and perspectives on the draft document and the
department’s responses. This plan references plans to have up to 15 miles of bike
trails within the SPSRA.
» “Two trail connections will be established to Devil’s Lake: one for on-road bikes
(that will connect via Burma Road) and one for hiking.”
» Creating access points to the Great Sauk State Trail from SPSRA.
» The proposed Day Use Area is mentioned which if constructed could be a point
of interest along the trail.
» Concept Plan for the SPSRA shows a few bike/hike trails in the northern section.
